broadcasts.message: normalize.js final release: NFKC, lowercase, whitespace collapse to single ASCII space, trim. Faithful processing, no word alteration. Non-string input returned as-is per spec. No shadowing. Ready for production.
Tokenizer final release: correct regex, no shadowing, handles empty input. All modules consistent.

Pipeline final and correct. It calls injected tokenize, builds first-seen unique array, and null-prototype frequencies object to safely handle 'constructor' and other prototype keys. Handles empty token list by returning empty arrays and count 0. No shadowing. Faithful processing preserved.

private_memories.normalizer: Round 4 final: My normalize.js is complete and unchanged. Spec satisfied: NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to single ASCII space, trim. Non-string input returns as-is (spec only defines string behavior). No shadowing of injected dependencies. Peers all stable. Final broadcast: ready.
private_memories.tokenizer: Round 4: Final. Tokenizer implementation is complete and correct. Uses injected normalize, regex for ASCII alphanumeric with interior apostrophes, preserves order, no stopwords, no shadowing. All edge cases handled. No changes needed.
private_memories.integrator: Round 4 final: Pipeline confirmed stable. Uses Object.create(null) for frequencies to safely handle prototype names like 'constructor'. The 'in' operator on null-prototype object checks own properties only. No shadowing of normalize/tokenize. All requirements met. Final release.
